market_summary: All monitored assets are consolidating inside or at extremes of their value areas during late NY session hours. FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) remain depressed near session lows at fair value (POC), while US100 and BTCUSD hold structural uptrends above VWAP/VAH but face resistance overhead. High-confluence short-term momentum triggers are absent across the board, favoring a capital-preservation stance (HOLD).

signals.rationale: Price is below_val (VAL 4018.13, POC 4044.14) following a strong flush. CVD is BEARISH (-3.30) aligning with aggressive selling during NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price trades well below VWAP (4032.78) and EMA50 (4017.56), extended near the lower ATR band (3988.11). GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING (Gamma Flip 3994.09), amplifying downward momentum. However, price is approaching Session Low (3982.90) and extended into the lower ATR band with decreasing volume, making fresh short entries poor risk/reward. HOLD preferred.

signals.level_event: rejection of Put Wall #1 / Prev Low

signals.rationale: Price is inside value area (VAL 1.10824, POC 1.10920, VAH 1.11455), hugging the POC. CVD is strongly BEARISH (-15,734) agreeing with overall downtrend in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price trades below VWAP (1.11236) and EMA50 (1.11123), hovering mid-channel near EMA20. Low RVOL (0.662) indicates consolidation at low levels rather than active expansion. Being at fair value (POC) without active catalyst signals HOLD.

Price is inside value area (VAL 1.32661, POC 1.32813, VAH 1.33233) right under POC. CVD is NEUTRAL (-1,768) with positive short-term slope (+235.94) during NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (1.33057) and EMA50 (1.32959), consolidating around EMA20. Volume is low (RVOL 0.382). Lack of directional delta and consolidation at POC warrants a HOLD.

Price is above_vah (VAH 28343.60, POC 28267.73) in strong uptrend during NEW_YORK_SESSION. CVD is BULLISH (+12.01), confirming buyer dominance, though short-term cvd_slope is negative (-1.95). Price holds above VWAP (28220.30) and EMA50 (28333.74). GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below Gamma Flip (28466.33), and price is directly below Call Wall #1 (28549.13). US100 tick volume displays normal RVOL (0.855). Chasing longs into Call Wall #1 with price right below Gamma Flip offers poor location. HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish above VWAP and EMA50 baseline
signals.level_event: rejection at Call Wall #1 / Session High

signals.rationale: Price is above_vah (VAH 73998.28, POC 73660.42) following strong push up in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price remains above VWAP (73807.13) and EMA50 (74001.87), holding above local support (74254.90). However, CVD is BEARISH (-0.07) showing mild divergence against price, and RVOL is quiet (0.802). Price is consolidating mid-range between support and Session High (74706.20). HOLD for clean retest or breakout confirmation.
